title: The Drop From Anywhere (Part 2)
style: big band jazz phonk, female lead coach vocal, walking bass, brass groove, half-time phonk kick, long drill track, spoken coaching bridges, choir final chorus, technical pickleball training anthem, call and response
lyrics:
[Verse 4 — Kitchen line reset drop]

You're at the kitchen, ball comes fast and high

No backswing needed — just a soft reply

Hands are quiet, paddle face stays open

Absorb the pace — that's the secret token

Follow-through points DOWN toward the floor

Soft hands, short stroke — that's all it takes, no more

The ball will arc up, cross the net, land soft

Reset from the kitchen — every time, be the boss

[Pre-Chorus — call and response]

(coach) — Where's the follow-through?

(player) — Pointing DOWN!

(coach) — Where's the backswing?

(player) — None around!

(coach) — What are the hands?

(player) — Soft and still!

(coach) — What's the landing?

(player) — PAST THE KITCHEN — on the hill!

[Chorus]

DROP IT FROM ANYWHERE

ARC IT OVER THE NET

DROP IT FROM ANYWHERE

SOFT HANDS — NO REGRET

Open face, brush up and through

Let the arc do what it's supposed to do

DROP IT FROM ANYWHERE

THAT BALL FINDS THE KITCHEN EVERY TIME

[Verse 5 — Arc math by court position]

From the baseline — long swing, high arc rise

More loft needed — ball travels a longer drive

From mid court — medium swing, medium flight

Shorter distance — dial the arc just right

From the kitchen — no swing, just a touch

Minimal motion, the net is close — don't rush

The backswing length IS the equation

Court position tells you the calculation

[Bridge 2 — spoken over groove, three positions]

(spoken, deliberate)

Three positions. Three swings. One destination.

Baseline — long swing. High arc. Soft landing deep.

Mid court — medium swing. Medium arc. Lands in transition.

Kitchen — no swing. Whisper touch. Drops just past the net.

The ball doesn't know where you're standing.

But you do.

So the swing changes.

The arc changes.

The landing — stays the same.

Soft. Low. Unreturnable.

That's the drop from anywhere.

That's the formula.

[Final Chorus — full choir, big band explosion]

DROP IT FROM ANYWHERE

ARC IT OVER THE NET

DROP IT FROM ANYWHERE

SOFT HANDS — NO REGRET

Baseline swing — long and high

Mid court dial — watch it fly

Kitchen touch — soft reply

DROP IT FROM ANYWHERE

THAT BALL FINDS THE KITCHEN EVERY TIME

DROP IT FROM ANYWHERE

EVERY COURT POSITION — EVERY TIME

[Outro — brass fades, spoken]

Baseline.

Mid court.

Kitchen line.

Three positions.

One drop.

Every time.

That's your formula.
